why: This is the Tyger Claws' restaurant in Japantown where Gig: Olive Branch ends: Sergei's car is delivered to the Claws here and, in vanilla, the diner can turn into a firefight. The shell, interior, furniture, lighting and door are part of the always-loaded district sector, but the quest's openworld section - the four Claw workspots, their triggers and the interior_trigger variant - is only loaded by the gig's post-delivery phase, so in the clean slate the diner stands intact and empty. This proposal loads that section, restores the four Tyger Claws (three guard/lean-smoke stands outside the counter, one cellphone stand inside) in their relaxed 0_default phase, and sets the variant to the normal post-delivery state (interior_trigger 0). Nothing of the delivery is restored: no car, no Alex in the trunk, no Sergei, no fight trigger.

open_questions: Walk up to the diner and confirm you can get in. Vanilla closes and unpowers #jpn_01_restarant_doors during the gig and only the post-delivery phase unlocks it; check the front door opens from the terrace/street without a terminal or keycard, and report any DoorPolicy unlock.

Count the Claws. Four Tyger Claws should be on their stands - Enemy_01/03 handguns, Enemy_02 blade, Enemy_04 rifle - leaning, smoking or standing guard around the diner, with one cellphone stand inside; confirm nobody is in a combat crouch or inside the kitchen.

Check they do not attack on sight. The wiki says the Claws only turn hostile if the delivery is antagonized; the diner should read as an occupied gang hangout and the security area must not flag combat.
Confirm the diner is not fight-staged. interior_trigger must be 0: the dining room open, furniture upright, no knocked-over tables, bodies or sealed-off area left from the shootout variant.
Check nothing starts the gig. Walking in must not start Gig: Olive Branch, show a quest marker, or spawn Sergei's car, Alex or a delivery trigger; report any journal pop-up or marker.
Watch the VenueProbe log on approach. The anchor is the restaurant door in the always-loaded devices prefab; confirm _prox is reached so the second activation runs.
Judge the crowd. Vanilla has no staff, cook or patron community here, so the diner is four armed Claws and no customers; tell the lead if that looks too empty for an open restaurant.
Confirm the venue has an in-game name. The wiki calls it only the Tyger Claws' restaurant/diner; read the sign and report any proper name so the display name can be corrected.

variant_toggles.why: interior_trigger is the gig's diner-fight switch. The gated gig phase (sts_wbr_jpn_01) turns it on (1); both normal-looking phases - the ungated manager boot state and the post-delivery openworld phase - set it to 0. Setting 0 gives the intact, open-for-business diner rather than the sealed fight staging.

proximity_wait.why: The restaurant's double door, a DoorControllerPS in the venue's devices prefab (#jpn_01_restarant_doors, vanilla's typo). It is driven by the gig phases, sits in the always-loaded exterior sector (not inside the interior_trigger variant), and is the first quest device a player meets walking up to the diner. A workspot would never fire (rule 8).
